method: Complete named explanatory fields from the exact subject/pointer. Original summaries, subjects and historical reviews unchanged. This is an excerpt, not a standalone replacement contract or review.

summary.answer: Takes menu f1_arg0, controller f1_arg1 and eight layout bounds f1_arg2..f1_arg9; calls LUI.UIElement.new and sets the literal class/id/sound. Creates the text image, three lower ambient squares, the central gadget image and three upper ambient squares, retaining the literal alpha and source insertion order. No strike behavior or callback is implemented here. Exact child order: Text, AmbientSquare6, AmbientSquare5, AmbientSquare4, GadgetR, AmbientSquare3, AmbientSquare2, AmbientSquare1. All layout/property/asset values and each callback body are retained in the ordered trace. Calls the optional same-file-or-unresolved PostLoadFunc at its exact source position, then returns self; a same name in another file supplies no binding. Base/child lifetime, model/event/animation delivery and native asset behavior remain external unless a reused exact provider contract explicitly supplies the bounded fact.
